The Chinese characters for Lucy

Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Lucy is usually read as “light”.

About the name Lucy

Saint Lucy is the patron saint of the blind, and a heroine of the Peanuts comic.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Lucy carries the meaning “light” and looks striking in brush strokes.
